name: Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz - § 50 - Am 34
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 50. Regrets that the Agreement does not include an enforceable commitment to effectively implement the Paris Agreement on Climate Change, the Convention on Biological Diversity and all international environmental agreements that the EU or Mexico have respectively ratified;
